cultivate: Spiritual mist curls through the air as {name} sinks into meditation. Each breath draws a thread of 灵力 (spiritual qi) into the dantian.
{name} closes their eyes. The world falls away until only the slow tide of qi remains, pressing against the walls of the meridians.
Somewhere beyond the clouds, the Heavenly Dao exhales. {name} catches the drift of that breath and turns it into power.
The stone beneath {name} warms with absorbed qi. A passing elder nods in quiet approval — a 练气 (Qi Refiner) is born of such patience.
{name}'s spiritual sense expands like ink in water, tasting the 灵脉 (spirit veins) threading through the earth.
Dust dances around {name} in slow spirals — each mote caught in the gravity of their cultivation.
The old master's words echo in {name}'s mind: 'Cultivation is a war of inches, won in silence.' Tonight, {name} wins another inch.
{name} practices the breathing cycles of the Mortal Meridian art. The 周天 (heavenly cycle) turns, slow and inexorable.
A strand of qi, thin as spider silk, finally yields to {name}'s coaxing and settles into the dantian. Progress, however small, is still progress.
Rain falls beyond the meditation cave, but within, {name}'s heart beats in time with the pulse of the earth.
{name} feels the 瓶颈 (bottleneck) shift — barely — like a mountain acknowledging a pickaxe. The Dao is patient, but so is {name}.
Golden motes of qi drift from the surrounding spirit herbs, drawn by {name}'s hunger for power.
The tribulation clouds do not yet gather, but they sense {name}'s ambition. Good. Ambition is the seed of ascension.
Through half-lidded eyes, {name} watches the stars. The Heavens watch back, and for a moment, the Dao seems almost friendly.
{name}'s meridians hum a low chord as qi flows through them — the first note of a symphony that will shake the nine heavens.
A fox spirit watches from the treeline, entranced by {name}'s cultivation. Even beasts sense when a mortal begins to transcend.
